To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
inhibition of the renin angiotensin system stimulates the expression of CO2X in the macula densea, which could form a novel, indirect negative feedback control loop for the renin system.
inhibition of the renin angiotensin system stimulates COX-2 gene and protein expression in the macular densa.
the inhibition of the renin angiotensin system by angiotensine converting enzyme inhibition and angiotensin type 1 receptor blockade upregulates cyclooxgenase 2 expression in the renal macula densa.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the reninangiotensin-aldosterone system in the regulation of COX-1 and COX- 2 in the macula dense.
the regulation of the expression of COx-2 in the macula dense and the role of the renin angiotensin system in the regulation of this enzyme.
the role of the reninangiotensin and prostaglandin systems in the macula-densa-mediated control of renin secretion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the stimulation of macula densas COX-2 is not triggered by the activation but by the inhibition of the renin angiotensin system.
inhibition of the renin angiotensin system (RAS) upregulates COX-2 in the macula.
the stimulation of macula dens expression by a low-salt and/or angiotensin-converting enzyme-inhibitor treatment can not be explained by a stimulation of angiotensin type 2 receptors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
inhibition of the RAS upregulates COX-2 in the macula dense and that angiotensin-II is an inhibitor of this COX-2 upregulation.
the inhibition of the renin angiotensin system leads to an increase in the macula dense COX-2, which in turn leads to a further increase in renin synthesis and renin secretion.
the inhibition of the renin angiotensin system by angiotensins type 1 receptors upregulates cycloxygenase 2 expression in the renal macula densa.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the macula densan-derived prostaglandin synthesis is regulated by the renin-angiotesin system.
the macula densan is a target for the angiotensins.
angiotensin receptor blockade increases COX-2 in the macula dense.
